name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Common Paper's standard mutual NDA terms that let two parties disclose confidential information to each other, e.g. while evaluating a potential business relationship. Used together with Mutual-NDA-coverpage.md.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: The fillable cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing purpose, effective date, term, confidentiality period, and governing law/jurisdiction. Incorporates the Mutual-NDA.md Standard Terms by reference.

name: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA)
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for giving early adopters access to a product in exchange for feedback, defining the design partner program, feedback ownership, and confidentiality.

name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
description: Common Paper's standard SLA, designed to be used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement, defining uptime and response time targets and the service credit remedies if those targets are missed.

name: Professional Services Agreement (PSA)
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for procuring professional services, covering statements of work, deliverables and intellectual property, payment, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
description: Common Paper's standard DPA governing the processing of personal data between a controller/processor and their vendor, including subprocessors, international data transfers, security incidents, and audit rights.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for licensing on-premises or client-side software, covering license grant, restrictions, updates, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for business partnerships involving mutual obligations, trademark licensing, and revenue or fee arrangements between a company and a partner.

name: Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
description: Common Paper's standard HIPAA business associate agreement, defining how a service provider may use and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard short-term trial or evaluation agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product or service before committing to a longer-term deal such as a CSA or Software License Agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper's standard addendum for products with AI or machine learning features, covering permitted use of AI services, input/output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-specific disclaimers.
